title: Usage skill carries the facts a team needs when it sets up from the skill alone
outcome: Usage skill carries the facts a team needs when it sets up from the skill alone
acceptance: docs/skills/engram-use/SKILL.md states that agents must never write secrets, credentials or customer data into Engram, and that a secret written by mistake must be rotated because stored history keeps it.
The skill states that the store home belongs on a local, non-synced path, given explicitly at every launch point.
The skill states the project-file resolution rule as it is after w-ae6006fe7852 lands: the nearest .engram-project found by searching up from the working directory, or an explicit --project-file.
The skill's pointer block no longer names a path on one person's machine (C:\github\Personal\Engram) or a mutable master URL; it tells the reader how to locate the skill in their own checkout.

completion.summary: Delivered the portable usage skill's four setup facts: stored-text restrictions and secret rotation, explicit local non-synced home at every launch, nearest ancestor marker selection with explicit override, and operator-confirmed checkout pointer. Exact authority wording concurred and audited; full nine-stage gate, Codex/Claude whole-input pair, independent 4/4 acceptance, and all four live stores ready. Installed clean release before verified push; existing processes retain prior build until supported restart.
